title: Salak Agro Jeep Sunrise
short_description: Discovery amazing sunrise view points in Bali without climbing, just sit down on the classic 4WD car to the hill top.
description: Discovery amazing sunrise view points in Bali. Without climbing, just sit down on the classic 4WD car to the hill top (approximately 1.200m above sea level). When the weather are clear, enjoy the beautiful sunrise view of the eastern edge of Bali island, the huge of Mount Agung and the beauty silhouette of Mount Rinjani in Lombok. Followed by campfire - picnic breakfast. Driving back down the hill to explore, feel the harvesting sensation and direct consuming Salak fruits from the tree.

itinerary.activity: Arrive at our base camp, classic 4WD car ready for the jeep Sunrise activities.
The journey will begin in the morning and pass through the plantations, bamboo forests. A little rocky and climbing road allows a sensation of natural adventure sensations.

Start with the campfire and set the typical picnic breakfast. Enjoy the fresh air on the hilltop and the beauty of nature at the turn of the night and sunrise. When the weather are clear, enjoy the beautiful sunrise view of the eastern edge of Bali island, the huge of Mount Agung and the beauty silhouette of Mount Rinjani in Lombok. Followed by campfire - picnic breakfast. Trekking surround the hill top.
Explore, feel the harvesting sensation and direct consuming the Salak Fruits from the largest plantation in Bali.

inclusions: Return hotel transfer with air-conditioned van
exclusions: Tipping for local guide, tour leader

title: Salak Agro Eco Trekking
short_description: Explore the largest Salak plantation in Bali island, rice field and the traditional Sibetan village.
description: Explore the largest Salak plantation in Bali island, rice field and the traditional Sibetan village. The village that still keep the good environment and develops sustainable local culture and self help farming system based on the natural ecosystem. Approximately 2-3 hours trekking to the Salak plantation and interact with the local to visit their house with the daily activities including the traditional wine process.

itinerary.activity: Pick Up - Hotel pick up services depend on the hotel location.

Walk into the rice fields - Depend on the season, sometimes there is the possibility to interact with the farmer, while caring, plowing or harvest in plantation. Explore the largest Salak plantations and traditional villages at Sibetan village in the east Bali island. Harvesting and taste the Salak fruits from the tree. Also, see the traditional wine-making process. During the trek, the local community will be presented a young fresh coconut to freshen stamina.
Lunch - Typical lunch will presented at local restaurant.

inclusions: Return hotel transfer with air-conditioned van
exclusions: Tipping for local guide, tour leader

title: Glamping and Cooking with Enjoying Bonfire
short_description: Enjoy glamping in a quiet place with green views on a cliff, including coffee plantation tours and cooking Balinese chicken.
description: Enjoy a unique glamping experience in a quiet place with green views on a cliff, surrounded by coffee and fruit plantations. Participate in cycling, cooking chicken with Balinese spices in bamboo, and hunting Luwak at night.

itinerary.activity: Glamping Activity - Pick up and start to enjoy the glamping activity. The glamping area is located in a quiet place with green views on a cliff, surrounded by a coffee plantation and various fruit trees.

Cycling & Cooking - Have a cycling tour, taste Luwak Coffee, and in the evening, cook chicken with Balinese spices in bamboo. Enjoy the bonfire and dinner together, followed by Luwak hunting at night.
Cooking Activity - Making traditional breakfast (boiled cassava with honey and Luwak coffee). Transfer back to the next destination.

exclusions: Tipping for local guide, tour leader

title: The Amazing of Blue Paradise
short_description: Discover the incredible West Nusa Penida, visiting Kelingking Beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Beach, and more.
description: Discover the incredible beauty of West Nusa Penida. Visit iconic spots like Kelingking Beach, Angel's Billabong, and Broken Beach. Experience snorkeling and sea walking to explore the rich marine life of Nusa Penida.

itinerary.activity: Kelingking Beach: Visit the T-Rex shaped cliff side at Kelingking Beach, one of the most famous spots on the South West coast of Nusa Penida.
Angel's Billabong: Explore the crystal-clear tide pool on the west coast of Nusa Penida.
Broken Beach: An incredible little cove with a natural arch on Nusa Penida island.
Snorkeling Activity - Snorkeling to watch beautiful fish and marine biota in very clear water.
Sea Walker - Unique undersea walking experience to discover the underwater world safely.

exclusions: Tipping for local guide, tour leader

title: Collect Memories in Undisan Village
short_description: Learn to cook and follow the daily activities of Balinese people in the charming Undisan Village.
description: The activities that you follow this tour will be taught to learn to cook and follow the daily activities of Balinese people. Journeys and programs are particularly varied: rice fields, waterfall, temples, villages, and a trek traversing the preserved forest of the island.

itinerary.activity: Trekking & Farming - Walking through rice paddies and participating in farming activities like cultivating the rice field using cows. Enjoy traditional refreshments afterward.
Tangkup Waterfall - Visit a quiet and small waterfall while trekking around the village.
Cooking Lesson - Experiencing how to cook Balinese cuisine in a traditional local house.
Making Coconut Oil - Learn the traditional process of making coconut oil from scratch using firewood.

exclusions: Tipping for local guide, tour leader

title: Community Base Tourism Activity
short_description: An immersive 3-day experience staying in local homes and participating in traditional Balinese village activities.
description: The trip to Undisan Village will take you to the heart of Balinese culture while following the curved tracks, traversing the remote villages, and exploring the sites well preserved from the touristy industry. Stay in local homes, learn to cook, and participate in daily activities together with local residents.

itinerary.activity: Upon arrival at Undisan Village, participate in a cooking lesson and stay in a traditional Balinese house compound.
Full day rural activities: visit the village school, short trekking through rice paddies, visit a natural waterfall, participate in farming, and learn how to make coconut oil.
Morning breakfast at the home stay and transfer out to the next destination.

title: Munggu Culture Cycling
short_description: Learn Gamelan and Balinese dance before cycling to the beautiful Munggu Beach.
description: A cultural journey starting at Warung Sawah Bali, visiting Royal Palace Griya Sidemen Pemaron, learning traditional Gamelan and Balinese dance, and concluding with a scenic cycling trip to Munggu Beach.

itinerary.activity: Gather at Warung Sawah Bali.
Visit Royal Palace Griya Sidemen Pemaron.
Learn traditional Gamelan and Balinese Dance.
Lunch at Warung Sawah Bali.
Cycling to Munggu Beach.
Explore and enjoy Munggu Beach.
